_comment: All decision-rule constants for PN3 arm c3. Edit here, not in code. D1: thresholds unchanged. D2: token rules use LOOP-ONLY tokens (R_LOOP = loop / A_BASE); R_B is reported only. D3: Haiku stratum. D4: one adaptive extension.
cost_policy: D6: cost is judged only after runs complete and enters only the final verdict; no loop, replicate, wave or experiment is ever stopped, truncated or skipped because of token or dollar cost. Caps on review count remain (not cost rules).
